title: ACQ Neutral Model Catalog
description: Per-provider, harness-neutral model catalog produced by a provider normalizer or shipped as its vendored fallback snapshot. Consumed by the models orchestrator kit (Layer 2) and harness kits (Layer 3). Carries model metadata only — no routing or credential fields. See integrations/isolation/docs/decisions/0004-neutral-model-provider-discovery.md §Neutral catalog schema.

schemaVersion.description: Schema identifier and version. Consumers MUST reject a document whose schemaVersion they do not recognise.

providerId.description: Identifies which provider kit produced this catalog. MUST equal the providerId in the co-located facts.json. Follows the same safe-slug rules as acq-provider-facts/v1: lowercase ASCII alphanumerics and internal hyphens, 1-32 characters. Uses (?![\s\S]) instead of $ to enforce fullmatch semantics; see acq-provider-facts.schema.json for the rationale.

models.description: Model entries available through this provider. MAY be empty — a provider that legitimately exposes no models is valid. Consumers MUST tolerate an empty array.

recommendations.description: Optional, advisory-only model role suggestions from the provider. Roles are neutral functional tiers — primary, small, compaction — not harness-native keys. Each value MUST reference an id present in this catalog's own models[]. Final role selection, conflict resolution, and harness-native vocabulary (e.g. OpenCode's model/small_model/compaction.model) remain in each agent kit. Consumers that do not understand a role MUST silently ignore it.

primary.description: Advisory default model id for general-purpose tasks. MUST reference a model id present in models[]. JSON Schema cannot enforce this cross-reference constraint; implementations MUST validate it separately (see _validate_recommendations in scripts/tests/test_provider_input_contract.py).

small.description: Advisory default model id for lightweight, fast, or low-cost tasks. MUST reference a model id present in models[]. JSON Schema cannot enforce this cross-reference constraint; implementations MUST validate it separately.

compaction.description: Advisory default model id for context-compaction or summarisation tasks. MUST reference a model id present in models[]. JSON Schema cannot enforce this cross-reference constraint; implementations MUST validate it separately.

model.description: Single model entry. Carries metadata only — no routing or credential fields. Host, baseUrl, modelsUrl, and keyEnv MUST NOT appear here.

id.description: Model identifier as used by the provider. Disallowed: ASCII control characters (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F) and Unicode line/paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029). The pattern uses (?![\s\S]) in place of $ to avoid the $ trailing-newline bypass ($ in ECMA and Python re matches before \n).

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for this model. Disallowed: ASCII control characters and Unicode line/paragraph separators. When absent, consumers SHOULD fall back to the model id.

contextWindow.description: Maximum input context window in tokens.

costAbove200kContext.description: Optional tiered pricing that applies when the input context window exceeds 200 000 tokens. Same per-million-token fields as cost. Consumers that do not support tiered pricing MUST fall back to cost.

cost.description: Per-million-token pricing. All fields optional. Values are in USD.
